title: Buttons, selects, tabs and icon actions show the default cursor on every admin view
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/probe.json: interactive elements with non-pointer cursor per view (desktop): /admin 5/22, users 7/24, cache 17/34, logs 65/82, pipeline 18/35, staging 159/176, annotations 39/56, releases 6/23, backups 13/30, settings 34/51, hybrid 14/31. Staging Approve button hover: cursor=default.
impact: Operators cannot tell actionable controls from static text in dense tables, which slows them down; it matches the known public-site report.
fix: Add `cursor-pointer` to the base class of buttonVariants, SelectTrigger, TabsTrigger, Switch, Checkbox, RadioGroupItem and DropdownMenuItem, or add one base-layer rule `button:not(:disabled),[role=button],[role=tab],[role=switch],[role=checkbox],[role=menuitem]{cursor:pointer}` in main.css.

title: The same status gets a different colour on each view: local status-to-variant maps disagree
evidence: completed = outline/neutral on /admin/pipeline (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_pipeline-desktop-light.png), primary blue on backups/hybrid, green dot in DataSourceProgress and green-700 on public /data-sources. running = primary on pipeline, violet `secondary` on backups. Inactive user = violet, inactive annotation source = red. Scheduler "Stopped" = red destructive (a normal state shown as an error).
impact: Operate mode relies on scanning colour. When "completed" is grey in one view and blue in the next, and "running" is blue in one and violet in another, a failed or stuck job is harder to spot, and colour stops meaning anything.
fix: Create one `StatusBadge` (status -> tone + icon + label) backed by semantic tokens (success, warning, info, danger, neutral, running). Delete the per-view getStatusVariant/getStatusColor/getStatusDotClass/getStatusBadgeClass/getRoleVariant maps and use it on admin and public views alike.

title: No success, warning or info tokens exist, so about 50 raw palette classes and 6 hex values carry status meaning in admin
evidence: Raw palette classes: AdminAnnotations 24, AdminPipeline 8, AdminReleases 7, AdminLogViewer 6, AdminGeneStaging 6, AdminCacheManagement 6, AdminHybridSources 5, AdminStatsCard 4, AdminSettings 3, AdminUserManagement 2, AdminDashboard 2, AdminBackups 2, backup dialogs 3. main.css defines only primary, secondary, destructive, muted, accent and chart-1..5. LogViewer.vue uses hex level colours.
impact: Every view hand-picks green-500, green-600 or green-400 and yellow-500, yellow-600 or yellow-700, so shades drift between views, several fail contrast, and dark mode depends on each author remembering a `dark:` variant.
fix: Add --success/--warning/--info (+ -foreground, + subtle bg) to :root and .dark, expose them in @theme, add Badge/Button variants success|warning|info, then replace the raw classes. Add a lint rule that bans raw palette classes outside the token layer.

title: `secondary` is a saturated violet, so every "secondary" badge or button looks like a loud accent
evidence: DEBUG level, priority 30-49, "manual upload", draft releases, inactive users, backups "running", the Validate Data/Refresh Cache buttons and the Logs Export button all render violet (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_annotations-desktop-light.png, admin_logs-desktop-light.png, admin_staging-desktop-light.png).
impact: In shadcn, `secondary` means low emphasis. Here it is the second-loudest colour on the page, so neutral metadata (a priority of 35, "manual upload") competes with real alerts, and three differently coloured filled buttons sit next to each other.
fix: Keep violet as a brand/chart colour but map Badge/Button `secondary` to a neutral (muted bg, foreground text) as in stock shadcn, or add a `neutral` variant and migrate the admin call sites.

title: Destructive badges and buttons put white text on red-500: 3.8:1, below AA for 12-14 px text
evidence: Computed contrast: white on light --destructive oklch(0.637 0.237 25) = 3.82:1. Seen on the "admin" role badge, the "Stopped" scheduler badge and the Clear Cache/Delete Expired Backups dialog actions (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/dialogs.png, admin_users-desktop-light.png).
impact: WCAG AA failure on the highest-stakes labels: destructive confirmation buttons and error chips.
fix: Darken light-mode --destructive to about oklch(0.55 0.22 25) so white reaches 4.5:1 or more, and use --destructive-foreground instead of hard-coded text-white (button/index.ts:12 too).

title: Yellow, green and orange status text fails contrast on white: yellow-600 2.9:1, green-600 3.2:1, orange-500 2.9:1
evidence: "Clean Up Old Logs" (yellow-600), the Annotations Pause button, the "Requires restart" badge in Settings, the Hybrid soft-delete dialog title and the bg-yellow-600/white action, the Pipeline "Added" counts (green-600), the Staging expert briefcase (orange-500). /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_logs-desktop-light.png, admin_pipeline-desktop-light.png.
impact: Warning and success text is unreadable for low-vision users and fails WCAG 1.4.3 in light mode.
fix: Use the new --warning/--success tokens, tuned to 4.5:1 or more for text (about amber-800 and green-700 in light mode).

title: Failed loads show the empty state ("No releases found") with only a transient toast; no admin view has an inline error state or skeleton
evidence: Load errors go to toast.error only (AdminUserManagement.vue:267-276, same pattern elsewhere), and the table falls through to "No releases found", "No backups found" or "No logs found". No admin view imports a Skeleton or ComponentError, while public views use ui/ComponentSkeleton and ui/ComponentError.
impact: An operator cannot tell "nothing exists" from "the API failed". After a backend outage, "0 backups" looks real, which matters on a backups page.
fix: One `DataState` wrapper (skeleton rows sized like the final table; empty state with explanation and primary CTA; error with message and Retry) built on the public ComponentSkeleton/ComponentError.

title: Two table implementations with different pagination, filtering and alignment
evidence: Users and Cache use ui/data-table (TanStack via h()). The seven other views use raw ui/table. Logs and Backups have "Apply Filters" and their own pager; Users and Releases filter live; Staging has no pager. Numeric columns (Entries, Size, Gene Count, Items) are left-aligned without tabular-nums.
impact: The same gesture (filter, page, sort) behaves differently on each view, and numbers do not scan.
fix: Standardise on ui/data-table for every admin list: live filtering, shared pager, right-aligned tabular-nums numeric columns, sticky header, scroll wrapper with a shadow affordance.

title: Row icon buttons in Users and Cache have no accessible name (tooltip only)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/probe.json "unnamed": 3 ghost icon tooltip-trigger buttons on /admin/users and 4 on /admin/cache without aria-label (edit/deactivate/delete user, details/clear namespace). Staging sets aria-label correctly.
impact: Screen-reader users hear "button" for Delete user and Clear namespace: destructive actions with no name (WCAG 4.1.2).
fix: Pass aria-label in the h(Button) props (e.g. `Delete user ${username}`), or use a shared IconAction component that requires a label and renders the tooltip from it.

title: The "Expert review only" and "Force update" switches are not programmatically labelled
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/probe.json unnamed: <button role="switch"> on /admin/staging and /admin/annotations; the <Label> has no `for` and the Switch has no id.
impact: A screen reader announces an unnamed toggle, and clicking the label does not toggle the switch.
fix: Give the Switch an id and the Label a matching `for`, or wrap both in a <Label>.

title: Section colour maps are dead code: AdminHeader iconColor, AdminStatsCard `color` and getAdminIconColor are never applied
evidence: AdminHeader renders <component :is="icon" class="size-6 mr-3"> without iconColor. AdminStatsCard declares `color` but always uses text-primary. getAdminIconColor (purple/orange/green/red/teal/indigo/violet/cyan...) has no callers. Views still pass color="success|warning|error|indigo".
impact: Readers think the stat cards are colour-coded when they are not. A dormant 11-hue section map invites someone to reintroduce arbitrary colours.
fix: Delete getAdminIconColor and the unused props. If tone is needed, derive it from StatusBadge tones (e.g. failed > 0 means danger).

title: 4-5 KPI cards on every view stack one per row on mobile and push the real work below the fold
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/m1.png, m2.png: at 390 px, /admin/logs, /admin/pipeline and /admin/staging show only stat cards (about 100 px each) before any filter or table. Several are vanity values: "Total Settings 14", "Requires Restart 0", "Recent Changes 0", "Scheduled Jobs 0".
impact: On a phone the operator scrolls about 500 px to reach the table. On desktop, numbers that restate the table add noise.
fix: Make AdminStatsCard a compact stat strip (2 columns on mobile, inline label/value), drop cards that duplicate table counts, and make filter-like cards clickable (Failed -> filtered list).

title: AdminHeader puts actions inline with the title, so on mobile the H1 wraps to one word per line
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/m1.png: "System / Logs" and "Data Pipeline / Control" wrap beside the action button, and the subtitle wraps over 3 lines.
impact: Ragged header on every admin page at 390 px.
fix: flex-col sm:flex-row with actions on their own row below sm, and hide the decorative icon on mobile.

title: Primary actions move around: in the page header on Backups, Logs and Staging, in the toolbar on Users and Releases, in a card on Cache and Pipeline
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_backups-desktop-light.png vs admin_users-desktop-light.png vs admin_cache-desktop-light.png
impact: The same affordance is in a different place on each view, so operators hunt for it.
fix: Rule: page-level actions go in the AdminHeader #actions slot; filters and search go in the table toolbar; destructive bulk actions are outline-destructive and placed last.

title: Destructive confirmations use different patterns, and some heavy or data-deleting operations have none
evidence: Cache, Backups and Users use AlertDialog (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/dialogs.png; good: copy names counts and irreversibility; Escape cancels). Log cleanup uses a plain Dialog with Buttons. The Hybrid "Replace" upload deletes existing provider data behind only an inline warning. Annotations "Refresh Cache" (materialized views) and "Retry Failed", and the Pipeline per-source "Run", fire immediately.
impact: Operators cannot predict which clicks are guarded. A replace upload can wipe curated evidence with one click.
fix: One ConfirmAction (AlertDialog) for all destructive or long-running operations: title = verb + object + count, body = effect + reversibility, action button labelled with the verb. Require it for Replace upload and the materialized-view refresh.

title: The focus ring is a 3 px ring at 50 % opacity of the sky primary (faint on white), and header links use a different black outline
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/focus-approve.png (pale cyan ring; computed box-shadow oklab(0.685 ... / 0.5) 0 0 0 3px). Header logo/nav get a black browser outline (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_users-desktop-light.png).
impact: The ring is probably under 3:1 against white, and two focus styles look inconsistent.
fix: Use ring-ring at full opacity with ring-offset-2, and apply the same focus-visible utility to header links.

title: No scrollbar-gutter: short admin pages (Users, Releases, Backups) and long ones will shift by the scrollbar width on classic-scrollbar systems
evidence: Not reproducible in headless Chromium (overlay scrollbars: breadcrumb and logo x = 96 on every route in the follow-up probe). No `scrollbar-gutter` in main.css or index.html. The header stayed at x = 0 across SPA navigation.
impact: Header and content jump horizontally between /admin/users (no scroll) and /admin/logs (scroll) on Windows and Linux desktops.
fix: html{scrollbar-gutter:stable} (the shared fix from the core group).

title: Coded chips (priority 35/45, log level, "manual upload", frequency, role) have no hover/focus explanation
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/probe.json: hovering the first badge on users, logs and staging shows 0 tooltips. A priority chip "35" (violet) has no scale or meaning.
impact: Operators must guess what priority 35 means and whether 80 is worse or better.
fix: StatusBadge/ScoreBadge accept a `description` rendered in a Tooltip (focusable). For priority, show "35/100" plus a tooltip explaining what drives it.

title: formatDate is redefined in 6 admin views; formats differ and Last Login appears off by one hour
evidence: Local formatDate in AdminGeneStaging:665, AdminCacheManagement:288, AdminHybridSources:439, AdminAnnotations:1002, AdminUserManagement:125, AdminReleases:533, despite utils/formatters.ts:5. Users shows "Last Login 3:29:03 PM" for a login made at about 4:29 PM local, while the logs from the same session show 4:29 PM (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_users-desktop-light.png vs admin_logs-desktop-light.png). The likely cause is a naive UTC timestamp parsed as local time (not verified in backend).
impact: An audit timestamp that is off by an hour misleads incident triage, and mixed formats ("10/27/2026, 4:29:09 PM" vs "10/27/2026 3:29:03 PM") slow scanning.
fix: Use one formatter in utils/formatters.ts (24 h, tabular-nums, time zone in a tooltip) and parse naive backend timestamps as UTC.

title: No skeletons on admin views: the previous route stays visible during the fade, then tables and stat values pop in
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/early1.png: 150 ms after navigating, the Home page is still fading. AdminStatsCard swaps the value for a 24 px spinner (a different height from the value).
impact: Small layout pops on every admin load, unlike the skeleton-backed public pages.
fix: Skeleton rows and value placeholders with the final dimensions, via the shared DataState.

title: Admin section cards are clickable <div>s: not focusable, no link semantics, no open-in-new-tab
evidence: Card with @click="navigateTo(section.route)" and cursor-pointer. Tabbing skips all 11 cards (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/probe.json focus sequence on /admin goes from the header to the footer buttons).
impact: Keyboard users cannot reach any admin section from the dashboard (WCAG 2.1.1).
fix: Render each card as a RouterLink (or a title link with a stretched ::after) so it is focusable, gets the focus ring and supports open-in-new-tab.

title: The Data Pipeline icon is a "minus" glyph that reads as empty or missing (dashboard card, KPI card, page header)
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin-desktop-light.png ("Pipeline Jobs" and "Data Pipeline" show a dash); /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_pipeline-desktop-light.png (header dash).
impact: It looks like a broken icon or "no data" on the most important operational card.
fix: Use lucide Workflow or GitBranch for the pipeline.

title: The dashboard is a brochure: green-check feature bullets instead of live status
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin-desktop-light.png: 11 cards with 4 green-tick bullets each ("Bulk operations", "Schedule automated runs"). Green (success) is used as decoration, while the scheduler is stopped, no backup exists, 25 errors were logged in 24 h and 402 items are pending; none of that is surfaced except "Pending Staging 402".
impact: Operate mode needs "what needs attention now". The ticks make every section look healthy, which contradicts the real state.
fix: Replace the bullets with one status line per section ("402 pending", "Scheduler stopped", "No backup yet", "25 errors / 24 h") using StatusBadge tones, and link each KPI to its filtered view.

title: Breadcrumb reads "Admin Dashboard > Dashboard", and each section has up to three names (breadcrumb, H1, card)
evidence: "Pipeline Management" (crumb) vs "Data Pipeline Control" (H1) vs "Data Pipeline" (card); "Annotation Sources" vs "Annotations Management"; "Hybrid Source Management" vs "Hybrid Sources".
impact: Users lose their place, and the same section goes by three names.
fix: Define one label per section (route meta) and use it for the breadcrumb, H1 and card. Drop the redundant crumb on /admin.

title: KPI cards (Pending Staging 402, Pipeline Jobs 0) are not clickable although they are the natural entry point
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin-desktop-light.png
impact: Extra clicks to reach the queue that needs work.
fix: Pass `clickable` and route to the filtered view (AdminStatsCard already supports it, with a focusable element).

title: The "admin" role is a red destructive badge and "Active" is filled primary, so roles look like errors; three role maps disagree
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_users-desktop-light.png. getRoleVariant: admin->destructive, curator->default, viewer->secondary. UserMenu: curator->secondary, viewer->default. Profile: admin->error, curator->warning.
impact: Red should mean failure or danger, and the same role changes colour between the header menu, the profile and user management.
fix: Roles are categories, not statuses: one neutral outline RoleBadge (optional icon) shared by UserMenu, Profile and admin.

title: On mobile the users table scrolls horizontally with no affordance; Role, Status and actions are off-screen
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_users-mobile-light.png: only Username, Email and "Full Na" are visible; the table is 889 px wide in a 342 px container.
impact: Delete and deactivate are not discoverable on a phone.
fix: Stack rows as cards below sm, or pin the actions column and show a scroll shadow.

title: "Total Entries 16" while the namespace rows sum to 8; the Clear dialog promises to "remove 16 entries"
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/m1.png (cache: total 16; rows 4+1+1+2 = 8; health shows Memory 8 + Database 8). Desktop run: total 12 vs rows 6. Dialog text in /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/probe.json.
impact: Counts double the L1 and L2 layers without saying so, and the destructive dialog states a number the table does not support.
fix: Label the layers ("8 keys, 16 entries across memory + DB") or show the namespace total, and use the same figure in the dialog.

title: The filled red "Clear All Cache" is the first and loudest button, next to the primary "Warm Cache", in an otherwise empty card
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_cache-desktop-light.png
impact: The most dangerous action has the highest visual priority, and the toolbar card wastes about 110 px.
fix: Move actions to the header slot: Refresh/Health ghost, Warm primary, Clear all outline-destructive and last.

title: Log levels: WARNING is a neutral outline, DEBUG loud violet, INFO filled primary; the frontend LogViewer uses hex grey/blue/amber/red
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_logs-desktop-light.png: every row has a filled blue INFO chip, and DEBUG stands out in violet.
impact: The noise (INFO, DEBUG) is louder than the signal (WARNING), and the two log UIs use two colour schemes.
fix: StatusBadge tones: DEBUG/INFO muted, WARNING warning, ERROR/CRITICAL danger, shared with components/admin/LogViewer.vue:79.

title: Method, Path, Status and Duration are "-" or empty for nearly every row, while the message is truncated without a tooltip
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_logs-desktop-light.png
impact: About 40 % of the table width carries nothing while the useful message is cut off.
fix: Collapse the request columns for non-request rows (or fold them into the message line), and give truncated messages a tooltip.

title: "Clean Up Old Logs" (a delete) is styled yellow, while the equivalent cache and backup actions are red or neutral
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_logs-desktop-light.png
impact: Inconsistent danger signalling, and the yellow text fails contrast (2.9:1).
fix: Use the shared outline-destructive style with ConfirmAction.

title: Source cards show "completed" as a near-invisible outline chip while "manual upload" is a filled violet chip
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_pipeline-desktop-light.png
impact: The status (the reason to visit) is the quietest element and a static label is the loudest.
fix: StatusBadge success tone for completed; neutral outline for the "manual upload" source type.

title: Every source shows "completed" from 3/15/2026 (7 months ago) and nothing signals staleness
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_pipeline-desktop-light.png
impact: Operators cannot tell that the evidence sources are months out of date.
fix: Show relative age ("226 days ago") in the warning tone once past the expected update frequency.

title: Only the first 50 of 402 pending items can be reached: no pager, no search, no sort
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_staging-desktop-light.png: "Pending Reviews (50)" vs "Needs Your Review 402". There is a "Results per page" select but no pagination control.
impact: Curators cannot reach 352 items or find a specific symbol, which blocks the review task. "(50)" also reads as the queue size.
fix: Add the shared DataTable pager plus a symbol search, and title it "Pending reviews: 1-50 of 402".

title: The intro alert breaks mid-sentence: "Your job is to either / approve / them with the correct HGNC symbol, or / reject / them..."
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_staging-desktop-light.png, m1.png. AlertDescription is a CSS grid, so each inline <strong> becomes its own row.
impact: The instructions at the top of the curation task are garbled.
fix:
Wrap the text in a

(AlertDescription already styles [&_p]), or drop `grid` from AlertDescription and audit other Alert usages.

title: "Expert Needed" shows a green check for "not needed" and an orange briefcase for "needed"
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_staging-desktop-light.png
impact: A green check under "Expert Needed" reads as "yes, needed", the opposite of its meaning, and the orange is 2.9:1.
fix: Show a warning-tone "Expert" badge when required, and a muted "-" otherwise. Add a header tooltip.

title: Priority >= 80 is red destructive, 50-79 neutral outline, 30-49 violet, < 30 primary blue: a non-monotonic scale
evidence: getPriorityVariant; all visible rows are violet 35 or 45 (/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_staging-desktop-light.png).
impact: Hue jumps (blue, violet, grey, red) do not read as low to high, and red implies an error.
fix: Plain tabular number plus a High/Medium/Low text badge in warning or neutral tones.

title: Candidate gene texts are bare codes with no HGNC lookup link or suggested match
evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-bernt-popp-development-kidney-genetics-db/87ac1b24-b55e-47f3-98f3-cc37d8f59427/scratchpad/audit-admin/admin_staging-desktop-light.png (PKD1A, COL_64, HNF1BA...).
impact: The curator must leave the app to check HGNC before approving.

title: Approve and Reject are adjacent 32 px ghost icons whose meaning is colour-only (green/red circles)
